whatIs.hwsw.integration.title: Kung Kailan Sila Nagkakatugma: Integrasyon ng Hardware at Software
whatIs.hwsw.integration.desc: Ang pagiging mahusay ng isang Computer Engineer ay ang co-design — ang paggawa ng mga desisyon sa hardware at software nang sabay-sabay upang ma-optimize ang performance, power, cost, at reliability. Ang systems-level thinking na ito ang nagdudulog sa Computer Engineering mula sa mga pinagmulan nito.
whatIs.fields.intro: Ang Computer Engineering ay sumasaklaw sa maraming magkaugnay na larangan. Karaniwang nagbuo ng kagiliran sa isa o higit pang mga larangan ang mga mag-aaral sa pamamagitan ng mga elective, proyekto, at pananaliksik.
whatIs.fields.item1.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: Microcontrollers, RTOS, C/C++, bare-metal programming
whatIs.fields.item1.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: Automotive ECU, medical devices, IoT sensors, industrial controllers
whatIs.fields.item2.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: ISA design, pipelining, cache hierarchy, parallel processing
whatIs.fields.item2.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: CPU/GPU design, high-performance computing, accelerator chips
whatIs.fields.item3.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: Verilog/VHDL, FPGA, ASIC flow, timing analysis
whatIs.fields.item3.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: Custom SoCs, AI accelerators, memory controllers, I/O interfaces
whatIs.fields.item4.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: TCP/IP, routing, switching, network security, QoS
whatIs.fields.item4.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: Data centers, 5G/6G, IoT connectivity, SDN/NFV
whatIs.fields.item5.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: DSP algorithms, filters, transforms, real-time processing
whatIs.fields.item5.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: Wireless comms, audio/video codecs, radar/sonar, biomedical imaging
whatIs.fields.item6.topics: Mahahalagang paksa: Control theory, sensor fusion, ROS, real-time control loops
whatIs.fields.item6.apps: Mga Aplikasyon: Industrial robots, autonomous vehicles, drones, surgical robots
whatIs.do.intro: Ang mga Computer Engineer ay nagtatrabaho sa buong lifecycle ng mga computing system. Ang kanilang trabaho ay kadalasang sumasaklaw sa mga sumusunod na pangunahing aktibidad:
whatIs.do.note: Paalala: Ang tiyak na paghahalo ng mga aktibidad ay nagbabago ayon sa role. Ang isang embedded engineer ay maaaring maglaon ng 80% ng kanilang oras sa firmware development, habang ang hardware engineer ay nagfo-focus sa circuit design at verification. Ang kalawakan ng Computer Engineering ay nagbibigay-daan sa mga graduate na mag-specialize batay sa interes.
whatIs.vsCS.title: Computer Engineering vs. Computer Science
whatIs.vsCS.intro: Parehong disiplina ay nagtatrabaho sa computing, ngunit magkaiba ang kanilang focus at scope:
whatIs.vsCS.row1.cpe: Hardware–software interface; mga system na nag-iintegrate ng both
whatIs.vsCS.row2.cpe: Malalim: circuits, architecture, digital logic, VLSI
whatIs.vsCS.row2.cs: Minimal: karaniwang isang architecture course lang
whatIs.vsCS.row3.cs: Malawak: applications, systems, web, AI/ML, theory
whatIs.vsCS.row5.cpe: Chips, boards, embedded devices, real-time systems
whatIs.vsCS.conclusion: Sa praktika, malaki ang overlap ng mga larangan. Maraming Computer Engineers ay nagsusulat ng maraming software, at maraming Computer Scientists ay nagtatrabaho sa hardware. Piliin ang Computer Engineering kung gusto mo ang maunawaan at i-design ang kumpletong computing system — mula sa pisika ng mga transistor hanggang sa software na tumatakbo sa kanila.
careers.comparison.title: Mga Kategorya ng Karera sa Isang Tanaw
careers.comparison.intro: Ang mga karera sa Computer Engineering ay sumasaklaw sa maraming kategorya. Ang paghahambing na ito ay tumutulong sa iyo na maunawaan ang focus at karaniwang entry point para sa bawat larangan.
careers.comparison.hwsw.focus: Pag-iintegrate ng both domains; full-stack systems thinking
careers.comparison.hw.roles: Hardware Engineer, ASIC/FPGA Engineer, PCB Designer
careers.comparison.hw.skills: Verilog/VHDL, SPICE, layout tools, test equipment
careers.comparison.sw.focus: Kod na tumatakbo sa hardware; applications & systems
careers.comparison.sw.roles: Software Engineer, Firmware Engineer, Systems Programmer
careers.comparison.sw.skills: C/C++, Python, Git, RTOS, debugging tools
careers.comparison.sys.roles: Systems Engineer, Network Engineer, Cloud/DevOps Engineer
careers.comparison.sec.roles: Cybersecurity Engineer, Security Analyst, Pen Tester
careers.comparison.sec.skills: Cryptography, threat modeling, secure coding, forensics
careers.comparison.emerging.focus: AI/ML, robotics, quantum, edge — cutting edge
careers.comparison.emerging.roles: AI/ML Engineer, Robotics Engineer, Quantum Engineer
careers.comparison.emerging.skills: PyTorch/TensorFlow, ROS, quantum algorithms, edge runtimes
careers.cta.title: Handa na ba para sa Iyong Karera sa CpE?
careers.cta.desc: Galugarin ang Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering program sa University of the East at itayo ang foundation para sa mapagtagumpay na karera sa teknolohiya.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.title: Bakit Mag-aaral ng CpE sa UE?
cpeAtUe.whyUE.intro: Ang Computer Engineering program ng University of the East ay nag-aalok ng natatanging mga bentaha na nakaugat sa kasaysayan, pasilidad, at koneksyon sa industriya.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item1.title: Accredited Quality
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item1.desc: Caloocan Campus: PAASCU Level III Re-Accredited. Manila Campus: PACUCOA Level II Candidate Status.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item2.title: Embedded Systems Focus
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item2.desc: Kurikulum na nakatuon sa embedded systems — ang computing technology sa mga pang-araw-araw na device — may hands-on projects mula freshman year.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item3.title: Licensure Performance
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item3.desc: UE Manila ay nag-ulat ng first-timers passing rate ng 93.33% sa 2025 Electrical Engineers Licensure Exam (na kasama ang CpE).
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item4.title: Industry-Recognized Graduates
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item4.desc: Ang mga graduate ay nananawagan ng mga role sa embedded systems, networks, software, at emerging fields sa lokal at international na industriya.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item5.title: UE Core Values
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item5.desc: Excellence, Integrity, Professionalism, Teamwork, Commitment, Transparency, Accountability, at Social Responsibility na naka-integrate sa buong programa.
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item6.title: Manila & Caloocan Campuses
cpeAtUe.whyUE.item6.desc: Dalawang campus na nagbibigay access sa tech ecosystem at industry partnerships ng Metro Manila.
spec.embedded.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.embedded.apps.list: Automotive ECU (engine control, ABS, infotainment); Medical devices (pacemakers, infusion pumps, monitors); Industrial controllers (PLC, motor drives, robotics); Consumer electronics (smart home, wearables, appliances)
spec.iot.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.iot.apps.list: Smart home systems (lighting, climate, security); Industrial IoT (predictive maintenance, asset tracking); Smart agriculture (soil monitoring, automated irrigation); Smart cities (traffic, waste management, utilities)
spec.networks.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.networks.apps.list: Enterprise network infrastructure (LAN/WAN, data centers); 5G/6G cellular networks at edge infrastructure; Content delivery networks (CDN) at cloud networking; IoT connectivity (LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, Zigbee)
spec.cyber.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.cyber.apps.list: Embedded device security (secure boot, firmware signing); Network intrusion detection at prevention systems; Hardware security modules (HSM) at trusted execution; Automotive/industrial control system hardening
spec.software.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.software.apps.list: Real-time embedded firmware at device drivers; Cross-platform desktop at mobile applications; Build systems, CI/CD pipelines, developer tools; High-performance computing at scientific software
spec.ai.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.ai.apps.list: Edge AI para sa real-time inference sa microcontrollers; Computer vision para sa quality inspection at robotics; Predictive maintenance gamit ang sensor data analytics; Natural language processing para sa embedded voice interfaces
spec.data.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.data.apps.list: Real-time streaming analytics para sa IoT sensor data; Manufacturing process optimization at quality analytics; Network traffic analysis at anomaly detection; Hardware/software performance profiling at optimization
spec.robotics.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.robotics.apps.list: Industrial manipulator arms at collaborative robots; Autonomous mobile robots (AMR) para sa logistics; Surgical at rehabilitation robotics; Automated inspection at quality control systems
spec.hardware.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.hardware.apps.list: Custom ASIC/FPGA designs para sa specialized computing; RISC-V at custom processor core development; Memory controller at cache hierarchy design; High-speed I/O interfaces (PCIe, DDR, SerDes)
spec.cloud.apps.title: Halimbawa ng Aplikasyon
spec.cloud.apps.list: Edge inference para sa real-time AI sa IoT devices; Hybrid cloud orchestration para sa industrial workloads; Content delivery at caching sa network edge; Distributed training at federated learning frameworks
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaEmbedded.title: Embedded Systems
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaEmbedded.desc: Isang pangunahing larangan ng Computer Engineering na sumasaklaw sa microcontroller-based design, real-time operating systems, at IoT device integration. Ito ay isang pangkalahatang Computer Engineering specialization area.
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaEmbedded.note: [Mga UE-specific track electives ay ibibigay pa]
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaNetworks.title: Networks & Security
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaNetworks.desc: Isang Computer Engineering area na sumasaklaw sa network protocols, cybersecurity, at cloud infrastructure. Ito ay isang pangkalahatang Computer Engineering specialization area.
cpeAtUe.curriculum.areaNetworks.note: [Mga UE-specific track electives ay ibibigay pa]
